findings: One introduced error-ordering regression: move stale-transaction refusal after expression evaluation; the retained native regression asserts Go ErrInvalidJSONText 3140.
One probe false negative: exception tuple repr escaped an apostrophe; compare the actual wire error message instead.

The initial new assertion incorrectly expected 3141. Go JSON_EXTRACT coerces to JSON through ParseBinaryJSONFromString and ErrInvalidJSONText (3140); the corrected assertion follows those sources. See order-test-failure.log (65 passed, one failed server case).
